乘坐.en: I've never been on a ship.

演讲.en: Unfortunately I was not in time for his speech.

演讲.zh: 她在演讲比赛中取得了第一名。

状态.es: Es imposible vivir sin agua y sin oxígeno.

媒体.pinyin: Guān yú zhè ge wèn tí wǒ jué de lā jī méi tǐ zhǐ bào dào le hěn piàn miàn de xìn xī
媒体.en: Concerning this issue, I feel that the trash media only report biased information.

媒体.zh: 媒体对他所说的话断章取义并发展到无法控制的地步了。
媒体.pinyin: Méi tǐ duì tā suǒ shuō de huà duàn zhāng qǔ yì bìng fā zhǎn dào wú fǎ kòng zhì de dì bù le
媒体.en: Just one part of what he said got picked up by the media and took on a life of its own.

媒体.zh: 媒体近几个月只讨论一件事：经济危机。
媒体.pinyin: Méi tǐ jìn jǐ gè yuè zhǐ tǎo lùn yī jiàn shì jīng jì wēi jī
媒体.en: The media has only discussed one thing in the last few months; the economic crisis.

连续.zh: 这个男人连续说了一个小时的话。
连续.pinyin: Zhè ge nán rén lián xù shuō le yī ge xiǎo shí de huà
连续.en: The man kept talking for an hour.
连续.es: Ese hombre estuvo una hora hablando.

连续.pinyin: Yǔ lián xù xià le wǔ tiān
连续.es: La lluvia estuvo cayendo durante cinco días.

连续.zh: 比尔连续哭了几个小时。
连续.pinyin: Bǐ ěr lián xù kū le jǐ ge xiǎo shí
连续.en: Bill kept on crying for hours.

岸.pinyin: Wǒ men yán zhe hú àn sàn bù
岸.en: We walked along the shore of the lake.
岸.es: Paseamos por la orilla del lago.

岸.zh: 大部分的学生来自西海岸。
岸.pinyin: Dà bù fen de xué sheng lái zì xī hǎi àn
岸.en: The students were for the most part from the West Coast.

岸.zh: 他们沿着非洲西岸航行了。
岸.pinyin: Tā men yán zhe fēi zhōu xī àn háng xíng le
岸.en: They sailed along the west coast of Africa.

岸.zh: 台湾是个位於太平洋西岸的岛国，人口约两千三百万。
岸.pinyin: Tái wān shì gè wèi yú tài píng yáng xī àn de dǎo guó rén kǒu yāo liǎng qiān sān bǎi wàn
岸.en: Taiwan is an island nation in the western Pacific Ocean with a population of roughly 23 million people.

伸.zh: 本把他的双手伸到了他的裤兜里。
伸.pinyin: Běn bǎ tā de shuāng shǒu shēn dào liǎo tā de kù dōu lǐ
伸.en: Ben put his hands in his pockets.
伸.es: Ben metió las manos en sus bolsillos.

伸.pinyin: Māo gōng qǐ bēi shēn le gè lǎn yāo
伸.en: The cat arched its back and stretched itself.
伸.es: El gato arqueó la espalda y se estiró.

伸.pinyin: Lín dá bǎ shé tou shēn le chū lái

伸.zh: 汤姆把手伸向了书架上最高的一本词典。
伸.pinyin: Tāng mǔ bǎ shǒu shēn xiàng le shū jià shàng zuì gāo de yī běn cí diǎn
伸.en: Tom reached for a dictionary that was on the very top of the shelf.

夸.pinyin: Wǒ jiù dāng nǐ kuā wǒ le
夸.en: I'll take that as a compliment.

夸.pinyin: Wǒ yào yī kuā tuō de niú nǎi
夸.en: I want a quart of milk.

夸.zh: 我都不知道该怎么夸他们了。
夸.pinyin: Wǒ dōu bù zhī dào gāi zěn me kuā tā men le
夸.en: I cannot praise them too highly.

编辑.pinyin: Nǐ bù xiǎng zuò biān jí
编辑.en: You don't want to be an editor?

编辑.zh: 我们应该对人使用基因编辑吗？
编辑.pinyin: Wǒ men yīng gāi duì rén shǐ yòng jī yīn biān jí ma
编辑.en: Should we use genetic engineering on people?

设施.zh: 这套房子设施便利齐全。
设施.pinyin: Zhè tào fáng zi shè shī biàn lì qí quán
设施.en: The house has all the conveniences.
设施.es: La casa tiene todas las comodidades.

设施.zh: 小区安全吗？夜晚有照明设施吗？
设施.pinyin: Xiǎo qū ān quán ma yè wǎn yǒu zhào míng shè shī ma
设施.en: Is this community safe? Are there lighting installations for the night?

因而.zh: 中国幅员辽阔,因而茶的品种繁多。
因而.pinyin: Zhōng guó fú yuán liáo kuò yīn ér chá de pǐn zhǒng fán duō
因而.en: China's territory is vast, thus the types of tea vary.

日用品.zh: 你去那个超级市场，几乎甚么日用品都买得到。
日用品.pinyin: Nǐ qù nà ge chāo jí shì chǎng jī hū shèn má rì yòng pǐn dōu mǎi dé dào
日用品.en: If you go to that supermarket, you can buy most things you use in your daily life.

区域.zh: 在我的邻近区域有一个大超市。
区域.pinyin: Zài wǒ de lín jìn qū yù yǒu yī ge dà chāo shì
区域.en: There is a big supermarket in my neighborhood.
区域.es: En mi barrio hay un gran supermercado.

区域.zh: 在加拿大有很多区域砍伐树木是非法的。
区域.pinyin: Zài jiā ná dà yǒu hěn duō qū yù kǎn fá shù mù shì fēi fǎ de
区域.en: In Canada, there are many areas where it is illegal to log trees.
区域.es: En Canadá hay muchas áreas donde es ilegal talar árboles.

区域.zh: 环境污染可以对一个区域的生态造成极大的影响。
区域.pinyin: Huán jìng wū rǎn kě yǐ duì yī ge qū yù de shēng tài zào chéng jí dà de yǐng xiǎng
区域.en: Pollution has a disastrous effect on the ecology of a region.
区域.es: La polución tiene un efecto desastroso sobre la ecología de una región.

区域.zh: 援救人员为了找到孩子，仔细搜索了那个区域。
区域.pinyin: Yuán jiù rén yuán wèi le zhǎo dào hái zi zǐ xì sōu suǒ le nà ge qū yù
区域.en: The rescuers searched the surroundings in hopes of finding the child.
区域.es: El rescatista recorrió el área en búsqueda del niño.

评论.zh: 我的评论引起了小组内的争论。
评论.pinyin: Wǒ de píng lùn yǐn qǐ le xiǎo zǔ nèi de zhēng lùn
评论.en: My comment sparked off an argument in the group.
评论.es: Mi comentario hizo que el grupo empezara a discutir.

评论.pinyin: Xiè xie nín de píng lùn
Hái méi yǒu rèn hé píng lùn
Huān yíng zuō rèn hé píng lùn

欺负.pinyin: Tā bèi tóng xué qī fu
欺负.en: He was made fun of by his classmates.
欺负.es: Sus compañeros de salón se burlaron de él.

欺负.zh: 我就爱欺负不懂中文的人。
欺负.pinyin: Wǒ jiù ài qī fu bù dǒng zhōng wén de rén
欺负.en: I really enjoy taking advantage of those who don't understand Chinese.

欺负.pinyin: Tā qī fu bǐ tā xiǎo de hái zi

眼神.zh: 她的眼神里充满了悲伤。
眼神.pinyin: Tā de yǎn shén lǐ chōng mǎn le bēi shāng
眼神.en: Her eyes were full of sadness.
眼神.es: Sus ojos estaban llenos de tristeza.

眼神.zh: 她的眼神里充满了悲哀。
眼神.pinyin: Tā de yǎn shén lǐ chōng mǎn le bēi āi
眼神.en: Her eyes were full of sadness.
眼神.es: Sus ojos estaban llenos de tristeza.

眼神.zh: 和别人握手的时候，一定要有眼神接触。
眼神.pinyin: Hé bié ren wò shǒu de shí hou yī dìng yào yǒu yǎn shén jiē chù
眼神.en: When you shake hands with somebody, you must look him in the eye.
眼神.es: Cuando sacudes manos con alguien, debes mirarlo a los ojos.

眼神.zh: 别用怨恨的眼神看我啦。
眼神.pinyin: Bié yòng yuàn hèn de yǎn shén kàn wǒ lā
眼神.en: Stop giving me such a venomous look.

厌恶.zh: 我厌恶每个人，每个人都厌恶我。
厌恶.pinyin: Wǒ yàn wù měi ge rén měi ge rén dōu yàn wù wǒ
厌恶.en: I detest everyone, and everyone detests me.

厌恶.zh: 我对他们无耻的行径感到厌恶。
厌恶.pinyin: Wǒ duì tā men wú chǐ de xíng jìng gǎn dào yàn wù

抢劫.pinyin: Bǎ shǒu jǔ qǐ lái zhè shì qiǎng jié
抢劫.en: Hands up! This is a robbery.
抢劫.es: ¡Arriba las manos! Esto es un atraco.

抢劫.zh: 这家银行一周前被抢劫。
抢劫.pinyin: Zhè jiā yín háng yī zhōu qián bèi qiǎng jié
抢劫.en: The bank was held up a week ago.
抢劫.es: El banco fue robado hace una semana.

古怪.zh: 你有没有发现他说话的语气有点古怪？
古怪.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu méi yǒu fā xiàn tā shuō huà de yǔ qì yǒu diǎn gǔ guài
古怪.en: Did you pick up on that strange tone in his voice?
古怪.es: ¿Te diste cuenta de ese tono extraño en su voz?

古怪.zh: 我知道人们认为我古怪。
古怪.pinyin: Wǒ zhī dào rén men rèn wéi wǒ gǔ guài
古怪.en: I know people think I'm odd.

古怪.pinyin: Tā de xìng qíng gǔ guài

古怪.zh: ”那你怎么看玛丽？“ ”她看起来挺古怪的。“
古怪.pinyin: Nà nǐ zěn me kàn mǎ lì tā kàn qǐ lai tǐng gǔ guài de
古怪.en: "So what do you think of Mary?" "She has a rather peculiar appearance."

砸.zh: 我实在气得不得了，所以打算砸东西发泄。
砸.pinyin: Wǒ shí zài qì de bù dé liǎo suǒ yǐ dǎ suàn zá dōng xi fā xiè
砸.en: I am really extremely angry, so I plan to smash things to vent my anger.

砸.zh: 他们把箱子砸成了碎片。
砸.pinyin: Tā men bǎ xiāng zi zá chéng le suì piàn
砸.en: They knocked the box to pieces.

砸.zh: 把安全帽戴上。这里很可能会有砖块砸到你头上。
砸.pinyin: Bǎ ān quán mào dài shang zhè lǐ hěn kě néng huì yǒu zhuān kuài zá dào nǐ tóu shàng
砸.en: Put your hard hat on. You might well get a brick fall on your head here.

砸.zh: 车头的挡风玻璃被砸至粉碎。
砸.pinyin: Chē tou de dǎng fēng bō li bèi zá zhì fěn suì
砸.en: The front windshield of a car was smashed to pieces.

钦佩.pinyin: Wǒ hěn qīn pèi tā de cái gàn
钦佩.en: I feel admiration for his talent.

钦佩.zh: 我很钦佩他的慷慨大方。
钦佩.pinyin: Wǒ hěn qīn pèi tā de kāng kǎi dà fāng
钦佩.en: I had great admiration for his generosity.

鞠躬.pinyin: Tā xiàng nǚ wáng jū gōng
鞠躬.es: Él se inclinó ante la reina.

鞠躬.zh: 在日本，遇到人鞠躬是有礼貌的表现。
鞠躬.pinyin: Zài rì běn yù dào rén jū gōng shì yǒu lǐ mào de biǎo xiàn
鞠躬.en: In Japan, it is polite to bow when one meets someone.

鞠躬.zh: 没有人向他恭敬地鞠躬。
鞠躬.pinyin: Méi yǒu rén xiàng tā gōng jìng de jū gōng
鞠躬.en: No one respectfully bowed towards him.

鲜明.zh: 中国之治与西方之乱形成了鲜明的对比。
鲜明.pinyin: Zhōng guó zhī zhì yǔ xī fāng zhī luàn xíng chéng le xiān míng de duì bǐ
鲜明.en: There is a stark contrast between China's order and the chaos of the West.

鲜明.zh: 广场被鲜明的灯火照亮。
鲜明.pinyin: Guǎng chǎng bèi xiān míng de dēng huǒ zhào liàng
鲜明.en: The square was illuminated by bright lights.

咀嚼.zh: 食物在吞咽前要经过咀嚼。
咀嚼.pinyin: Shí wù zài tūn yàn qián yào jīng guò jǔ jué
咀嚼.en: Food should be chewed before being swallowed.
咀嚼.es: La comida se debe masticar antes de tragarla.

奖励.pinyin: Tā bèi jiǎng lì le yī kuài jīn biǎo
奖励.en: He received a golden watch as a prize.
奖励.es: Como premio recibió un reloj de oro.

奖励.pinyin: Tā yǒu quán dé dào jiǎng lì
奖励.en: He is entitled to receive the reward.
奖励.es: Él es apto para recibir el premio.

奖励.zh: 秘密的礼物公开的奖励。
奖励.pinyin: Mì mì de lǐ wù gōng kāi de jiǎng lì

气色.zh: 她的气色看起来比以前好。
气色.pinyin: Tā de qì sè kàn qǐ lai bǐ yǐ qián hǎo
气色.es: Ella parecía más animada que antes.

气色.pinyin: Nǐ kàn qǐ lai qì sè bù tài hǎo

淘汰.zh: 在上一届世界杯上，新西兰在比赛中被墨西哥淘汰。
淘汰.pinyin: Zài shàng yī jiè shì jiè bēi shàng xīn xī lán zài bǐ sài zhōng bèi mò xī gē táo tài
淘汰.en: In the last World Cup, New Zealand was knocked out of the competition by Mexico.

淘汰.pinyin: Dé guó bèi hán guó táo tài
淘汰.en: Germany was eliminated by South Korea.

高峰.zh: 当时正是早高峰，来来往往的行人和车辆很多。
高峰.pinyin: Dāng shí zhèng shì zǎo gāo fēng lái lái wǎng wǎng de xíng rén hé chē liàng hěn duō
高峰.en: It was the morning rush hour, and there were a lot of passing pedestrians and cars.

高峰.zh: 你认为日本第二高峰是哪座山？
高峰.pinyin: Nǐ rèn wéi rì běn dì èr gāo fēng shì nǎ zuò shān
高峰.en: What do you think is the second highest mountain in Japan?

博览会.pinyin: Bó lǎn huì jiāng jǔ xíng liù gè yuè
博览会.en: The exposition will be held for six months.

沐浴.pinyin: Qiū líng mù yù zài yáng guāng xià
沐浴.en: The hills are bathed in sunlight.

沐浴.zh: 小木屋沐浴在月光之中。
沐浴.pinyin: Xiǎo mù wū mù yù zài yuè guāng zhī zhōng
沐浴.en: The little cabin was bathed in moonlight.

耀眼.zh: 他就像七月四日的烟火一样耀眼！我心想：「哇！」
耀眼.pinyin: Tā jiù xiàng qī yuè sì rì de yān huǒ yī yàng yào yǎn wǒ xīn xiǎng wā
耀眼.en: He was bright like the 4th of July! "Wow!", I thought!

耀眼.zh: 湖水在耀眼的阳光下闪闪发亮。
耀眼.pinyin: Hú shuǐ zài yào yǎn de yáng guāng xià shǎn shǎn fā liàng
耀眼.en: The lake was gleaming in the bright sunshine.

自力更生.zh: 上天会帮助自力更生的人。
自力更生.pinyin: Shàng tiān huì bāng zhù zì lì gēng shēng de rén
自力更生.en: Help yourself and God will help you.

为期.zh: 大多数学生都在为期末考试复习。
为期.pinyin: Dà duō shù xué sheng dōu zài wéi qī mò kǎo shì fù xí
为期.en: Most students are preparing for the final exams.
为期.es: La mayoría de los estudiantes se está preparando para las pruebas finales.

准则.zh: 接受对方的准则就是给予他权力。
准则.pinyin: Jiē shòu duì fāng de zhǔn zé jiù shì jǐ yǔ tā quán lì
准则.en: Accepting the other's norms is submitting to the other's power.
准则.es: Aceptar las normas del otro es someterse al poder del otro.

外向.zh: 莱拉很外向、有爱心、会照顾人。
外向.pinyin: Lái lā hěn wài xiàng yǒu ài xīn huì zhào gu rén
外向.en: Layla was very outgoing, loving, and caring.

茂盛.pinyin: Tā zhǎng de hěn mào shèng

你们.zh: 请写信告诉我你们学校的情况。
你们.pinyin: Qǐng xiě xìn gào su wǒ nǐ men xué xiào de qíng kuàng
你们.en: Please write to me about conditions at your school.
你们.es: Escríbeme, por favor, sobre la situación de tu colegio.

你们.zh: 除了相信对方以外，你们没什么要做的了。
你们.pinyin: Chú le xiāng xìn duì fāng yǐ wài nǐ men méi shén me yào zuò de le
你们.en: All you need to do is trust each other.
你们.es: La única cosa que tenéis que hacer es confiar los unos en los otros.

你们.zh: 就像你们知道的那样，毅力是成功的关键。
你们.pinyin: Jiù xiàng nǐ men zhī dào de nà yàng yì lì shì chéng gōng de guān jiàn
你们.en: Perseverance, as you know, is the key to success.
你们.es: La perseverancia, como usted sabe, es la llave al éxito.

你们.pinyin: Nǐ men zhōu rì sòng huò ma

常.pinyin: Wǒ men guò qù cháng zài gōng yuán wán
常.en: We used to play in the park.

常.pinyin: Dàn shì tā bù cháng wēi xiào
常.en: But he did not often smile.
常.es: Pero él no sonríe con frecuencia.

常.zh: 我们常把黑色跟死亡联系起来。
常.pinyin: Wǒ men cháng bǎ hēi sè gēn sǐ wáng lián xì qǐ lai
常.en: We often associate black with death.
常.es: A menudo asociamos el negro con la muerte.

常.zh: 母亲常说时间就是金钱。
常.pinyin: Mǔ qīn cháng shuō shí jiān jiù shì jīn qián
常.en: My mother often said that time is money.
常.es: Mi madre decía a menudo que el tiempo es dinero.

公车.zh: 在公车上，一个陌生人和我说了话。
公车.pinyin: Zài gōng chē shàng yī ge mò shēng rén hé wǒ shuō le huà
公车.en: A stranger spoke to me on the bus.
公车.es: Me habló un extraño en el autobús.

公车.zh: 我在公车上给偷了钱包。
公车.pinyin: Wǒ zài gōng chē shàng gěi tōu le qián bāo
公车.en: I had my wallet stolen on the bus.
公车.es: Me robaron mi cartera en el autobús.

公车.zh: 你能把最近的公车站指给我看吗?
公车.pinyin: Nǐ néng bǎ zuì jìn de gōng chē zhàn zhǐ gěi wǒ kàn ma
公车.en: Can you tell me where the nearest bus stop is?
公车.es: ¿Puedes decirme dónde está la parada de autobús más cercana?

公车.zh: 我可能把雨伞留在公车上了。
公车.pinyin: Wǒ kě néng bǎ yǔ sǎn liú zài gōng chē shàng le
公车.en: I may have left my umbrella in the bus.
公车.es: Puede que haya dejado el paraguas en el bus.

游.pinyin: Wǒ men zài hú lǐ yóu le yǒng
Wǒ měi zhōu yóu yī cì yǒng
游.es: Nado una vez a la semana.

游.zh: 他试图游过河，但是失败了。
游.pinyin: Tā shì tú yóu guò hé dàn shì shī bài le
游.en: He failed in his attempt to swim across the river.
游.es: Él intentó cruzar el río a nado pero fracasó.

游.pinyin: Tā néng yóu de hěn kuài

纸.zh: 我要写一封信。你有纸吗？
纸.pinyin: Wǒ yào xiě yī fēng xìn nǐ yǒu zhǐ ma
纸.en: I have to write a letter. Do you have some paper?
纸.es: Tengo que escribir una carta. ¿Tenés papel?

纸.pinyin: Nǐ men yǒu méi yǒu zhǐ

纸.zh: 我需要写一封信。你有纸吗？

纸.zh: 有些人边看电视边读报纸。

变成.zh: 这些绿叶到秋天变成红色或黄色。

上海.pinyin: Nǐ lái shàng hǎi duō shao shí jiān le

上海.es: ¿Hace cuánto tiempo que está en Shanghái?

上海.zh: 去上海新建的绿地玩也特有劲！
上海.pinyin: Qù shàng hǎi xīn jiàn de lǜ dì wán yě tè yǒu jìn
上海.en: Visiting one of Shanghai's recently developed parks and green spaces is also exciting!

上海.zh: 上海夏天的最高温度要到三十八九度，真快热死了！

爸.pinyin: Wǒ bà hái méi huí jiā

怎么办.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhī dào gāi zěn me bàn

怎么办.zh: 老公性无能，我该怎么办？

怎么办.es: ¿Qué debería hacer si mi esposo es impotente?

橘子.zh: 我吃掉了我所有的橘子。

菸.pinyin: Wǒ bù huì zài chōu yān le
Wǒ liǎng nián qián jiè yān le
菸.en: I quit smoking two years ago.
菸.es: Dejé de fumar hace dos años.

菸.pinyin: Wèi le jiàn kāng wǒ bù zài chōu yān
菸.en: I stopped smoking for the sake of my health.
菸.es: Dejé de fumar por el bien de mi salud.

菸.en: "Do you have a match?" "I'm sorry, but I don't smoke."
菸.es: ¿Tiene usted un fósforo? Lo siento, pero no fumo.

司.zh: 我辞去了俱乐部司库的职位。
司.pinyin: Wǒ cí qù le jù lè bù sī kù de zhí wèi
司.en: I resigned from my position as club treasurer.
司.es: Renuncié a mi posición como tesorero del club.

司.en: This company and I have signed a contract of three years.
司.es: Esta compañía y yo firmamos un contrato a tres años.

司.pinyin: Tā zài nǎ jiā gōng sī gōng zuò
司.en: What company does he work in?

司.zh: 这家公司不分种族、宗教或国籍雇用人。
司.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōng sī bù fēn zhǒng zú zōng jiào huò guó jí gù yòng rén

司.es: Esa compañía contrata gente sin importar raza, religión o nacionalidad.

典.zh: 我总是在离手不远的地方放一本字典。

典.en: I always keep a dictionary close at hand.
典.es: Siempre tengo un diccionario a la mano.

典.es: Sin este diccionario no sé hacer nada, ni por un día.

厨师.pinyin: Wǒ shì gè hǎo chú shī
Wǒ men de chú shī jīn tiān hěn máng

厨师.es: Nuestro jefe de cocina está muy ocupado hoy.

厨师.zh: 我们有一位非常好的厨师。
厨师.pinyin: Wǒ men yǒu yī wèi fēi cháng hǎo de chú shī
厨师.en: We have a really good cook.

厨师.zh: 一个差劲的厨师和下毒者唯一的不同在於他们的意图。
厨师.pinyin: Yī ge chà jìn de chú shī hé xià dú zhě wéi yī de bù tóng zài yú tā men de yì tú
厨师.en: The only difference between a bad cook and a poisoner is the intent.
厨师.es: La única diferencia entre una mala cocinera y una envenenadora es la intención.

全世界.zh: 英语是一种全世界通用的语言。

全世界.en: English is a language spoken all over the world.
全世界.es: El inglés es un idioma hablado en todo el mundo.

全世界.pinyin: Lún dūn shì quán shì jiè zuì dà de chéng shì zhī yī
全世界.en: London is one of the largest cities in the world.
全世界.es: Londres es una de las ciudades más grandes del mundo.

全世界.zh: 全世界百分之八十电脑上的资讯都是用英语写的。

全世界.es: El ochenta por ciento de la información almacenada en los ordenadores de todo el mundo está en inglés.

全世界.zh: 全世界许多国家的人说英语。
全世界.pinyin: Quán shì jiè xǔ duō guó jiā de rén shuō yīng yǔ
全世界.en: English is spoken in many countries around the world.
全世界.es: El inglés es hablado en diversos países alrededor del mundo.

陌生人.en: A stranger spoke to me on the bus.
陌生人.es: Me habló un extraño en el autobús.

陌生人.zh: 盯著陌生人看是不礼貌的。

陌生人.es: Es grosero quedársele viendo a los desconocidos.

陌生人.en: A stranger came into the building.
陌生人.es: Un extraño entró en el edificio.

陌生人.zh: 我不想和一个陌生人分享旅馆房间。
陌生人.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng hé yī ge mò shēng rén fēn xiǎng lǚ guǎn fáng jiān
陌生人.en: I don't want to share the hotel room with a stranger.
陌生人.es: No quiero compartir la habitación del hotel con un desconocido.

一眼.pinyin: Tā kàn le yī yǎn tā de biǎo
一眼.es: Él le echó un vistazo a su reloj.

一眼.pinyin: Tā qí guài de kàn le wǒ yī yǎn
一眼.en: She gave me a strange look.
一眼.es: Ella me echó una mirada extraña.

一眼.en: She didn't so much as look at me.

一眼.zh: 我能看一眼那本杂志吗？

预定.pinyin: Wǒ méi yǒu yù dìng zhè ge

预定.zh: 我能预定一下打高尔夫球吗？
预定.pinyin: Wǒ néng yù dìng yī xià dá gāo ěr fū qiú ma
预定.en: Can I make a reservation for golf?
预定.es: ¿Sería posible hacer una reservación para jugar golf?

预定.zh: 我们按时预定了产品。然而，要到下个月后才能发货。
预定.pinyin: Wǒ men àn shí yù dìng le chǎn pǐn rán ér yào dào xià gè yuè hòu cái néng fā huò

预定.es: Hicimos el pedido de los productos a tiempo. Sin embargo, no serán enviados hasta el mes que viene.

吸.zh: 我用吸尘机把地上的灰尘吸掉了。
吸.pinyin: Wǒ yòng xī chén jī bǎ dì shang de huī chén xī diào le
吸.en: I sucked up the dust on the floor with a vacuum cleaner.
吸.es: Aspiré el polvo del suelo con una aspiradora.

囚犯.en: The prisoner was behind bars for two months.
